properties.title: U.S. Census Grids (Summary File 1), 2010
properties.description: The U.S. Census Grids (Summary File 1), 2010 data set contains grids of demographic and socioeconomic data from the year 2010 in ASCII and GeoTIFF formats. The grids have a resolution of 30 arc-seconds (0.0083 decimal degrees), or approximately 1 square km. The gridded variables are based on census block geography from Census 2010 TIGER/Line Files and census variables (population, households, and housing variables).
properties.ciesin:tags: Country, State, Boundaries, Society, Population, Earth Science, Human Dimensions
properties.ciesin:purpose: To provide gridded demographic data, including characteristics of age, race, ethnicity, and housing, for the United States and Puerto Rico for data integration.
properties.ciesin:data_format: raster, map; raster, map, map service; raster; document
ciesin:contacts: Center for International Earth Science Information Network (CIESIN) Metadata Administration
NASA Socioeconomic Data and Applications Center (SEDAC)
